purpose: Decisions taken about the audit's own evidence bytes, recorded so that any change to an evidence digest is explained rather than silent.
note: Timestamps are deliberately omitted: this package must be byte-reproducible. Ordering is established by git history.

trailingWhitespaceLine.content: the GPG-signature survey line, ending '... aa7d4db N 0bea3fa N ' with one trailing space
trailingWhitespaceLine.surveyMethod: A precise byte-level scan of every committed file under docs/audit, audits/phase-a and tests/red found EXACTLY ONE genuine trailing-whitespace line in the whole audit tree. An earlier grep-based scan reported additional matches in several Markdown files; those were false positives and are not reproduced by the byte-level check.
trailingWhitespaceLine.cause: Mechanical artifact of the command that produced the line: `git log --format='%h %G?' | tr '\n' ' '`. The tr conversion turns the final newline into a space, leaving one trailing space at end of line.
trailingWhitespaceLine.decision: PRESERVED. The bytes are unchanged and the file's digest is unchanged.
trailingWhitespaceLine.reasoning: The directive permits correcting an accidental line provided any resulting hash change is documented. The audit chose preservation for three reasons. (1) The file is committed evidence of what a command actually emitted; editing evidence after the fact, even cosmetically, is the class of action the truth contract discourages. (2) The file is NOT covered by audits/phase-a/package-manifest.json, so the whitespace creates no verification failure anywhere. (3) Correction would require documenting a digest change for zero analytical benefit. Documenting the cause achieves the same clarity at no cost to evidence integrity.
trailingWhitespaceLine.reversible: If Codex/Michael prefer correction, the change is one byte and this note records precisely what would change and why.

unusedImportsRemoved.change: Two unused `import crypto from "node:crypto";` statements were removed.
locations: tests/red/c1-cross-runtime-artifact-identity.test.mjs - the OUTER import. All crypto usages in that file occur inside the HARNESS template literal, which carries its own import, or use require() inside the probe template.
tests/red/c2-source-byte-gate.test.mjs - zero usages in executable code.
unusedImportsRemoved.verification: ESLint (the repository's own configured linter) reports exit 0 with no findings on tests/red after removal. Both red tests were re-executed after the change and fail with identical assertion messages and identical pass/fail/skip counts: C1 2 fail, C2 5 fail + 4 skip.
unusedImportsRemoved.behaviouralChange: None. Removing an unused binding cannot alter execution.
unusedImportsRemoved.reasonNotInManifest: tests/red/ is not part of audits/phase-a/ and is therefore not covered by the package manifest.

packageManifestRegeneration.event: package-manifest.json was regenerated to cover the addendum artifacts added in this pass.
packageManifestRegeneration.invariantAsserted: The SHA-256 of every pre-existing EVIDENCE artifact is UNCHANGED. Only new entries are added. This is verified mechanically and the verification output is recorded in the commit that introduces this file.
packageManifestRegeneration.manifestExcludesItself: package-manifest.json cannot contain its own digest and is excluded from its own artifact list.

deliberateExceptionREADME.reason: README.md is the package's own table of contents. Leaving it unchanged while adding five artifacts would make it inaccurate, which is a worse failure than a documented digest change. Its Contents table and the superseded-claims section were updated to list the addendum artifacts.
deliberateExceptionREADME.classification: DOCUMENTATION, not evidence. No measurement, digest, command output or observation recorded in README.md was altered.

uncertainty: The byte-level whitespace scan covers only files tracked under docs/audit, audits/phase-a and tests/red at this commit. It does not cover the repository's pre-existing files, which are out of scope for this audit's own evidence hygiene.
independentlyReproduced: The trailing-whitespace survey was performed once, by a byte-level reader independent of the grep that produced the earlier false positives.
